notes.title: Oh no! Renowned Explorers is now 10 years old.
notes.notes:
[p][i](Psst, before we start... Be sure to [/i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/abbeygames" style="button" buttoncolor="#009d00"]follow Abbey on Steam[/url] [i]if you want to stay in touch with us!)[/i]

Oh sweet mother of God, remember 2015? Remember?! When you picked up Renowned Explorers, even though (*checks early reviews) it looked like a "Mobile Game"?  That is 10 years ago.[/p][p][/p][h2]Ten years!![/h2][p][/p][p]It was the year of Jurassic World. Woke was still woke. A time before the great plague, and before all the other plagues too. Old people didn't find the real internet yet. We did extensive marketing on Facebook back then, which worked [i]just as well[/i] as it does today. 

This shark had a tough time in 2015. Did he know that in 2015, we arrived at the apex of modern humanity? Did he peeked into the future, and thought "Snap snap, it's all downhill from here. Let's dance for the lost future, Katy". [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9244308/68a387f951ba165d72ed5d11155bf6814152edee.jpg"][/img][/p][p]2015, what a time to be alive. In 2256, when Renowned Explorers 2 is finally anounced on your Google Brainslurper, the explorers will be cybersurfers in the year 2015. They will be exploring the memes and greenlit games that showcase the best the internet had to offer.  [/p][p][/p][h3]10 years Renowned Explorers[/h3][p]But what a ride for Renowned Explorers! You all by now know that we almost croaked under Renowned Explorers failure at launch. Only by the blessings of St. Totalbiscuit that Abbey Games survive.  Together with the community we ran community challenges, our bi-weekly source of joy!  [/p][p][/p][p]We created two expansions with more fun for you to explore. Campfires. Islands, Vases to break. It was glorious. [b]Glorious.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9244308/7bb105b3428a691355b16d598523f7c394fb1fa6.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]But everything that starts, must end. Renowned Explorers, even though it's beloved by many of those who give the damn game a try, was never going to be big enough to support our mortal coils. We had to move on, and so we went to make Godhood. It was very hard, and it didn't work out the way we wanted. So as a last shot at keeping making games, we made Reus 2. Luckily, that one is doing well for us! (Because it's a [b]good game, [/b]folks). [/p][p]Even now, we always have to come to the conclusion that Renowned Explorers was never really meant to be. Godhood - which we consider our weakest game - still outperforms Renowned Explorers 4 to 1 in 2025. Renowned Explorers might have the personality, but it doesn't have the face. It's the harsh reality of making video games for a living. 

But it is still in our hearts. As are you, who have pushed us and Renowned Explorers to places we couldn't have imagined 1 day after release.

So here comes my attempt to befriend you:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9244308/83d4f71a3a668e559b2d103f9c296a4adddea43d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We often think back to Renowned Explorers. We had so much fun in that period, a time with a lot of creativity and unawareness of market restraints that were forming on Steam. A time with a lot of fun, and a beautiful group of players that made the game alive for everyone.

We're honored you all allowed us to do this. That you laughed at my dumb writing with even dumber spelling, loved our characters, and pushed the adventure forward. It was amazing having fun with you.

[/p][p][b]From the bottom of our hearts, thank you. Keep adventuring, keep learning, and keep a lighthearted love for the world.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]....[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]No, we're not wrapping up Abbey Games! We're even working on something new! It's in the earliest of phases, but who knows... this might be up your alley as well?  
Be sure to  [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/abbeygames" style="button" buttoncolor="#358a02"]follow us on Steam[/url]  if you want to stay in touch with us!  Who knows, maybe we'll meet each other at the next adventure!

   - All the best from the Abbey[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9244308/34b7051000ac5b723db333d9e3049ed5d1232236.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Reus 2 releases the 28th of May
notes.notes:
Hello good people!

Maybe you’ve heard it before, maybe it’s the first time you hear it: Next week on the [b]28th of May[/b] our newest game [b]Reus 2[/b] will hit the Steams! We’re happy to see the lessons we’ve learned from Renowned Explorers and Godhood put together into Reus to create a true fresh new Abbey Game!

Except what you can expect from us: depth, colorfulness, and a playful heart.

[h2]Ok, but why didn’t you create Renowned Explorers 2!?[/h2]
I get this question so often, I feel I need to elaborate more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9244308/ae8c690830aa1d9e8d8b85d61868677e4e4e1481.png[/img]
[i]Photo of Abbey Games trying to defend not working on RE:IS 2 on MonkeyCon, colorized[/i]

Renowned Explorers was a creative success. We loved working on it, and we love the game. Every game we made has something special, but for me Renowned Explorers is very special.

However Renowned Explorers doesn’t sell well and was expensive to make. There are too many good games in the roguelite, storylike, turn based genre. It’s also a very odd game: most of you had no idea what you were getting into except if you were enlightened by the eternal TotalBiscuit. Without him, Abbey Games would’ve been long gone after the release of Renowned Explorers. We got families to feed, and we got to make business choices.

To add, Renowned Explorers has more words than War & Peace. It has 3 layers of gameplay that all have their own art, code and UX. It’s a lot to make. We would need to seriously rethink what Renowned Explorers can be in this day and age.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/0/3950280854052371050/]And it has definitely nothing to do with raccoons[/url].


[h2]Take the next step with us[/h2]
Regardless, we’re super excited about Reus 2! It’s a big step for us, and we’re very happy with the result. Of course we want to share it with you who have been supporting us for all that time. It’s a major step up from the original, and we think you should give it a look! We hope you’ll find that Abbey vibe in there!

In any case, we’re grateful for your support in the past years. It’s a privilege to have a shot at entertaining you with our silly ideas. We hope for many more years of colorful creativity!

- Adriaan and the monks at the Abbey

notes.title: Tales of the Abbey: Renowned Explorers
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9244308/0507292c7d1be34f85d961883c0edf75c8381711.gif[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/222730/view/3215017876033167091]In the previous tales[/url], we shared stories of the start of Abbey Games. Today, we share about the exciting exploration of [b]Renowned Explorers![/b]

One thing was certain; The Abbey was filled with chaotic energy! All the monks, old and new, sat together and basically mashed ideas together to see what would come out. A big difference from the four that basically set the line for Reus! It's safe to say the game went in all kind of directions! It was going to be an action RPG! No, an RTS! No! A turn based game! No, a fighter!(?)[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9244308/e440bc1ce220b0c559bc618da2e6aecf0b096cac.png[/img]
[i]One of the early mock ups of Renowned Explorers.[/i]

Not only the game was an adventure, we even started making our own tech: AbbeyCore. It was an engine made from scratch. All these factors gave us a lot of fun, but also little to show in one year. And we only had one year left to make something! Safe to say, things were getting hot.... It was time to get serious...[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9244308/357cfbb7fe64cc9be05dec8da5fe789d96074de6.png[/img]
[i]Our attempt to getting serious.[/i]

The monks double downed on the events, treasures and characters, while keeping the encounters interesting and fresh. Of course, there was still room for fun. One event had the dialogue of an... adult... movie (without obscenity, think of Hildegard!) as a test case. However, it [i]did[/i] got sent for review by our editors, who were kind of puzzled on what this whole dialogue was about! Also, have you ever tried clicking on Earl's portrait in an encounter? You should. ;)

The release of Renowned Explorers was rocky at first, but a tight community and the helping hand of a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EXCleyTTShY]legendary reviewer[/url] helped the game to climb to the top! Would the Abbey even still be making games without that review? Maybe we would've switched to the darkside, creating AbbeyCoin or NFT's. Luckily, we don't live in that timeline!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9244308/87601b0bccd06ed08d875ef7bd8a47331cc95422.png[/img]
[i]A museum of your pieces, that sadly never made it.[/i]

We learned a lot from Renowned Explorers; [b]The humor and character of Renowned Explorers is an important thing for our current secret project! [/b]But after two expansions and a lot of fun creating stories and characters, it was time to move to the next game. The development of Renowned Explorers already showed some cracks in the walls of the Abbey, but Godhood would really force us to define ourselves.

Tune in next Monday to see the third chapter of our tales at the news section of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/917150/Godhood/]Godhood page[/url]!


P.S. If you want to chat with us, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/zBDM99WhnF]Discord[/url] or follow the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/abbeygames/]Abbey Games Developer[/url]!

notes.title: Abbey Games' Year in Review
notes.notes:
Hello explorers!

The year is coming to an end, and thus comes the ritual of reflecting on the past. As many of you have been following us loyally, we would like to share our thoughts with you! But first; some Godhood news!

[h2]Godhood Update 1.2 Coming Soon![/h2]
We’ve been working on a new update for Godhood, scheduled somewhere early 2021! We’re not going to give away much here, but it will include some new community ideas to add your religion! One important feature that has often been requested is the “Excommunicate” action. Soon it will be much easier to remove an unwanted Disciple from your roster.

Of course, sending a faithful Disciple away will impact morale a bit. But only the best get to serve you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/189f99ff399f2680ecb343ea2c85c3f61fdd2869.png[/img]
[h2]Reflecting on 2020[/h2]
Just like most people on this planet, we had a pretty crazy year. In January, we were at the point of calling it quits. Because of the disappointing Early Access track of Godhood and general mismanagement, we were at a total low point with no viable business left. Up to that point, Godhood development had been a true ordeal. We had two separate burn-outs in the team, and the quality of the game only improved at a slow pace. By the start of 2020, we had to let go of all of our employees and friends (You can follow a few of them at Roost Games!) whom we shared so many beautiful memories with. We, Maarten, Manuel and Adriaan, were the only ones left of our original team of over 10 people.

However, we thought Godhood to be in an unacceptable state. It was our duty to deliver you higher quality before we called it quits. So we set on a journey to release 1.0. After that, we would reevaluate our situation.

In that period, we re-learned a lot about making games. We had some critical moments where we compared the production of Godhood with that of Renowned Explorers and Reus. In the process, we found our joy back, and the ability to increase quality at a much higher pace. We couldn’t have done it without the support of the community - it was at one point literally the only thing that motivated us to move forward! We’re very grateful for all your kind words, constructive criticism, and all round fun interaction! In particular, we would like to thank the good folks on the Abbey Discord. It has been a joy. We’re proud of the results!

Lucky for us, this increase in joy and quality also changed our fortunes on Godhood! The game welcomed a lot of new players, and we’re happy to see many more people having fun with it. Because of that, we’re now in the position to look at the future!

[h2]The Future[/h2]
This newfound joy has motivated us to take a look into the future of the Abbey. We’ve started with cutting down some of our ambitions to focus on bringing better quality games. In the past 5 years, Abbey Games was very busy trying to manage a democratic and safe work environment. However, it seems we went too far. Too many of us were more busy managing and doing HR work instead of bringing you quality gameplay. With the 3 of us, we’re going back to our times during Reus and Renowned Explorers. That means more time developing, less time managing. We’re also saying goodbye to our engine AbbeyCore. It was a fun and enriching project, but we want to focus on our game quality. We hope to use more industry standards to make it easier to deliver our games faster and to more people.

This means we will fully devote ourselves to [b]deep and thematic strategy-likes[/b]. We’ve received quite some requests for a sequel to Renowned Explorers and Reus. We have a lot of love for these games, and are exchanging interesting ideas about them! We are also very excited to try new themes, too!  

So what does the future bring? We’re going to keep you guys in the dark a bit longer! But know that we’re working on [b]deep and thematic strategy-likes[/b], in the spirit of Reus and Renowned Explorers! We hope to use some of Steam’s new features to bring our new prototype to you as quickly as possible. We believe that together, we can make a really high quality game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/beb722d844207dd915f171acc97a4095d6ef7aff.png[/img]
[h2]Best Wishes[/h2]
Finally, we want to give you all our best wishes for your (a)religious festivities! We hope you can leave the chaos behind you for a while, and focus on the things that are truly important to you. Be it family, friends, health, or just some really good games! Thank you for reading, and we hope to see you in 2021!

Best wishes,
The Abbey

Developed by Renowned Explorers and – more relevantly – Reus studio Abbey Games, Godhood is a game about what it says on the tin. notes.title: Coming Soon: Renowned Explorers - Daring Dates DLC
notes.notes:
[b]Disclaimer: April Fools! [/b]

After the release of the original [b]Renowned Explorers[/b] in 2015 and the [b]More to Explore[/b] and [b]Emperor's Challenge[/b] DLC in 2016 and 2017 respectively, we're planning to release another expansion to the Renowned Explorers universe in 2018. The Renowned Explorers community has given us a lot of input about what direction they want the game to take and we figured it's about time we really listen. So without further ado, we're proud to present: [b]Renowned Explorers - Daring Dates![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9244308/10febe177be086934965777c60ab9905e2ffaf14.png[/img]

In this DLC, instead of taking a crew of three explorers on an epic adventure of tales and treasure, you can take one crew member... on a date! That might sound easier than it is, though. Renowned Explorers' band of characters is made up of seasoned explorers, and they are hard to impress! Where to go on your first date, for example? The Museum? Paris? Or straight to the exotic hideaways of the Emerged Island in the Caribbean? 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9244308/cee5dac59e64743b86007dd7331dbd356208abf6.png[/img]

And that's just picking the location... How about picking the right outfit?! A date is essentially a lot like an expedition: you have to prepare for it. Bring the wrong gear or start an encounter with an aggressive attitude and you might kill the mood in just one turn.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9244308/c1fef7aa6ada51a755133dbfaa03eaa3f341e7e2.png[/img]

If all goes well, though, and you play your cards right as a 19th-century globetrotting Casanova, you might even get the chance to go on a date with the most Renowned of all the Explorers: Mathieu Rivaleux! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9244308/9a8e735f4c5eaed5b3bfce2fe3864706f617fc3c.png[/img]

[b]Renowned Explorers: Daring Dates[/b] is still in development and it's too soon to pinpoint an exact release date. But if you want to stay posted and maybe even try your chances in a closed beta encounter with Anna or Victor, for example, be sure to sign up for the [url=http://reusgame.us6.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=a8cb3be367b8148a8f284a476&id=b8cbf27b92] Abbey Games newsletter [/url] or stay in touch through the Renowned Explorers community hub. We hope to see you on some adventurous dates sometime in 2018!

~ the monks from Abbey Games

notes.title: Welcome to all humble explorers!
notes.notes:
Hey explorer, good chance you're just coming in from this amazing [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/wild-frontier-bundle]Humble deal[/url]. In that case: Welcome aboard Renowned Explorers! There's a few things you might want to know before your first game...

Or actually, no. Just start playing your first game. You'll be fine. But perhaps read this introduction to Renowned Explorers' wonderful community right after.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9244308/83d4f71a3a668e559b2d103f9c296a4adddea43d.gif[/img]
[i]Emilia discovers a pirate with a budding interest in botany![/i]

So since you're here, it's worth knowing that Renowned Explorers' community is as vibrant as it is skilled and knowledgeable. Here are some pointers if you want to hop in, or simply want to learn more about the game:
[list]
[*] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/guides/]Player-made guides[/url]
[*] [url=renownedexplorers.gamepedia.com]A fan-made wiki[/url]
[*] This week's [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/0/133261907149856011/]Weekly Community Challenge[/url] (Open to all levels, but recommended after you've finished at least 1 playthrough)

[*] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/]Discussions[/url], get all your answers here. Like we said the community, the community is very knowledgeable, and friendly too! Plus, us devs we'll be reading everything there!
[*] If you have any technical issues, we'll be [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/1/]here[/url], at your service.
[/list]
Be sure to hang around, things are about to get interesting with our new expansion right around the corner! If you want to stay up to date, here are some options:
[list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/460390/

Good luck and have fun on your adventures,
~ Abbey Games

Abbey Games is working hard on the [b]upcoming expansion[/b]. We're at the point that all the new content and gameplay is coming together. notes.title: Cooperative Community Challenge for Content!
notes.notes:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/0/217690940938498458/]See the challenge right away.[/url]

For starters Challenge 50 is a cooperative challenge in which the community has a shared goal of achieving [b]100,000 to 500,000 Renown![/b] On top of that this challenge has a special set of rewards, of which the most exciting one is that the monks here at the Abbey will actually create unique new content if certain Renown thresholds are achieved. That's right, if you play a nice round of Renowned Explorers we'll squeeze in extra hours to get you new content for the upcoming patch. Of course the next DLC will be our main priority still. Find the full list of rewards below!

[h1]Rewards[/h1]
The challenge rewards depend on the total sum of Renown the community achieves:

[b]* BRONZE (100,000 Renown)[/b]
[list]
[*] Raffle 2 [i]REIS[/i] Steam keys among participants (to keep or give to friends)
[/list]

[b]* SILVER (200,000 Renown)[/b]
[list]
[*] Raffle 2 [i]REIS[/i] Steam keys
[*] Raffle 2 [i]More To Explore[/i] Steam keys
[*] We'll create and add the CORK HAT item to the game in the next patch.
[/list]

[b]* GOLD (350,000 Renown)[/b]
[list]
[*] Raffle 3 [i]REIS[/i] Steam keys
[*] Raffle 3 [i]More To Explore[/i] Steam keys
[*] Raffle 3 [i]Reus[/i] Steam keys
[*] We'll create and add the CORK HAT item to the game in the next patch.
[*] We'll create and add the HISTORY BOOK item to the game in the next patch.
[/list]

[b]* PLATINUM (500,000 Renown)[/b]
[list]
[*] Raffle 5 [i]REIS[/i] Steam keys
[*] Raffle 5 [i]More To Explore[/i] Steam keys
[*] Raffle 5 [i]Reus[/i] Steam keys
[*] We'll create and add the CORK HAT item to the game in the next patch.
[*] We'll create and add the HISTORY BOOK item to the game in the next patch.
[*] We'll create and add the BISCUIT BOX item to the game in the next patch.
[*] BONUS: During the stream we'll drop a hint towards the upcoming second DLC for Renowned Explorers.
[/list]

[h1]Livestream[/h1]
The result of this challenge, including the rewards, will be announced and celebrated in a Twitch livestream next week. If you don't want to miss it, [url=twitch.tv/abbeygames]subscribe to our channel[/url].

[b]Livestream date:[/b] 
Wednesday November 16 
19:00 CET / 10:00 PST

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/0/217690940938498458/]Link to the challenge[/url]

A third reason this challenge is very special is that its the 5th challenge that is set-up by the community itself (even though we stepped in to provide rewards). Originally we ran it ourselves, but when we decided to focus more on development instead, some members in the community stepped up to continue the tradition. We're grateful every week.

[h1]New DLC[/h1]
Don't forget, Abbey Games is working on a new paid DLC for next year which will be different from More To Explore in ways that yet need to be revealed. Make sure you're subscribed to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/296970]Game Group[/url] to be made aware when it comes out!

We hope you'll [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/0/217690940938498458/]participate[/url] in the challenge and show us what this community can do!

Have fun and see you next Wednesday,
Abbey Games

notes.title: Have You Played Renowned Explorers?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day of the year, perhaps for all time.

Renowned Explorers [official site] is the game that isn’t The Curious Expedition. Both games involve gangs of adventurers searching for treasure and fame in far-flung lands, and both have a distinct whiff of British imperialism and derring-do about them, though neither was developed in England. Where The Curious Expedition allows you to flatten entire regions with explosives and dark magic, Renowned Explorers is all about the power of friendship and good humour. Or at least, it can be.

notes.title: Patch #18: Shangri-Love and more.
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9244308/3930fb8970acdfd6399166b481a4178e1eee2876.png[/img]
Following renewed interest in the game, we're continuing work on Renowned Explorers through at least August. For now, that means a fresh patch #18, with juicy content and a ton of balance and fixes!

Let's go through some of the highlights. If you rather read the full patch notes, check [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/0/520518688938133991/]here[/url].

[h1]Shangri-La[/h1]
With the More To Explore expedition we released the Lost Island, a 5-star alternative to Shangri-La. It has proven very popular and many players like it better than the Tibetan expedition both in terms of fun and game value. To help Shangri-La back up to its legendary status, we created new content and did some balance changes and fixes in both expeditions. Visit Shangri-La for a new treasure and some new events!

[h1]Captain Hatice[/h1]
Hatice has a new captain perk! Many people don't know that the silent Hatice is a brilliant investor. It explains, feeds and expresser her greed. In Patch #18 we've made this into a new captain perk for her: [i][b]Investor[/b]: +10 Collect at the start of each expedition. Gain 2 insight if you end an expedition with 50 Collect or more.[/i] Can you achieve a proper Return of Investment?

[h1]No-one escapes destiny[/h1]
Over time Renowned Explorers has developed a dedicated community of [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/0/451852225133331297/]Weekly Challengers[/url]. We never expected this competitive part of the game to become a community focus, but now that it is, we felt the need to work on some randomness issues to disincentivize constant reloading. Roll-games and encounter arenas are now pre-determined at island generation, so that when you fail a challenge, you won't be able to succeed in it by reloading the game. There are also some miscellaneous fixes for exploits.

[h1]More adventuring[/h1]
On top of the above, Adriaan worked on a lot of balance to make the game more fun, based on community feedback. There are changes in cards, entourage, treasures, events and encounters. Check the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/0/520518688938133991/]full patch notes[/url] to find out more, or just start-up the game already ;)

Have fun on your adventures!

notes.title: Patch #17: Community Unlocked New Cities and Stories
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9244308/4154703938f56d31af9d7cced619a75b2436cd11.png[/img]

The [i]More To Explore[/i] release is just two weeks ago but it's already time for new content. Patch #17 adds the content that was unlocked in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/0/357287304440350655/]48-hour Community Content Challenge[/url] in which a whopping 190 explorers joined forces to unlock all tiers of content. So, what's new?

[h1]New Cities (Tier 3)[/h1]
The sheriff of San Francisco and the king of Muscat are very impressed with the spirit of the Renowned Explorers. To attract more renown to their own cities, they've opened up new facilities for explorers! San Francisco will open up a modest new Entourage shop, while Muscat will offer exotic trinkets in its humble bazaar. Naturally, Sydney and New Orleans will respond accordingly to this new competition on the market...

[h1]New Andean Quest (Tier 2)[/h1] 
Expansion owners may discover a new treasure in the Andean Adventure, but not before overcoming one of the hardest challenges among level 3 expeditions. Go explore, before this dark force consumes the Andes.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9244308/01e88750a46466da50ffbec258b1a7f1f3ad1d6f.png[/img]

[h1]New Stories (Tier 1)[/h1]
Wherever you go after this patch, you might meet some of the Entourage specialists during their travels. A few events scattered everywhere.

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
While working on new content, we've also worked to improve several features in the game. Most notably you can now swap items in the item shop by dragging a new item onto an equipped one... like in any RPG :) You can also dampen the pulsing Resolve and Research icons through the options and read more crewmember details in the Advanced Selection screen.

For more improvements and fixes, please read the extended [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/0/520518688938133991/]patch notes[/url].

Join the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/296970]Renowned Explorers group[/url] to stay up to date with new patches.

For now, enjoy the new content! And let us know what you think.

notes.title: Patch #15: New Entourage, Ivan, Balance & Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.renownedexplorers.com/files/hotlink/Patch15_RioEntourage.png[/img]
While Manuel is in Malmö, Sweden for the Nordic Game Conference, our Abbey is buzzing with work on the expansion for Renowned Explorers. We'll release info on that real soon. All I can say right now is that it's closer than you might think :)

In between the expansion work Adriaan and me found the time to create a small but interesting patch that adds a new entourage member, balances certain gameplay and fixes a number of reported issues. You can read the full patch notes [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/0/520518688938133991/?ctp=11#c357286663671173640]here[/url], but let's focus on a few things right here:

[h1]Rio Reworked[/h1]
Rio de Janeiro is a bustling town, always seeing people come and go. In this patch, we introduce [b]Flavia[/b], a new entourage member you can recruit by using Status. This also means that Rio now has 4 levels of entourage, allowing you to recruit 4 specialists.

[h1]Ivan's Captain Perk[/h1]
Ivan's captain perk has always been... polarized. With the new balance you get more of that juicy [b]Supply Capacity[/b] out of it. Of course you still have to deal with the [b]-1 Resolve[/b], stemming from Ivan's questionable leadership.

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
You'll also find some small changes in the research tree, and with the so called off-resource entourage members in Istanbul (Rami, Zafira and Amon). Read the patch notes for more changes, and the assorted gameplay fixes!
For now that's it, but check back soon to learn more about Renowned Explorers first expansion.

notes.title: Expansion: sign up for Closed Beta
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.renownedexplorers.com/files/closed_beta_header.png[/img]
Are you looking for more Renowned Explorers, both expeditions and features? Do you want to help us out? Sign up for the closed beta and join us in testing the upcoming expansion! We're also looking for entirely new players. Read about sign-ups on the bottom.

[b]Expansion[/b]
If you've been following development of Renowned Explorers, you already know that for the past few months we've been working on an expansion, alongside releasing patches. Our goal is to release more expeditions so that there are even more secrets and locations to explore. We're also improving and adding features so that the strategy, roleplaying and replayability of the game is improved!

[b]Why a Closed Beta?[/b]
By now we've completed most of the work, which means we can move into the closed beta phase. In this phase we want to test with a couple of dozen players in secrecy to find out whether new features and content work as intended. Does everything work as expected on the technical side? Any bugs? And are they fun for everyone's playing style? Participating in the beta means playing the game in secrecy, and talking directly with the devs and other testers about your findings.

[b]Testing with new players[/b]
Some mechanics are important immediately from the first playthrough (but can be enjoyed just as well if you're a long-time player). To test these we're looking in particular for players that have played very little or not at all. If you've just installed Renowned Explorers, please consider to sign up and already get the expansion experience, which we think is a big improvement over the base game. We also have slots for more experienced and veteran players.

[b]Signing up![/b]
To sign up for the Closed Beta, simply send an e-mail to [i]info at abbeygames dot com[/i]. Make sure to add the following info:
[olist]
[*]A link to your Steam profile. (even if private)
[*]Your current playtime and experience with Renowned Explorers (may be very litte, very much or none at all!)
[*]One or two lines about why you want to join.
[/olist]
We have a limit on the amount of testers, so it could be that you are not invited or only at a later point. In any case, we will let you know.

[b]More expansion info[/b]
Curious about the expansion? When we're satisfied that the expansion quality is good, we will send out more news about release date and pricing. From that point on you will hear more about its contents as well. Make sure you stay up to date by following us in one of the ways shown on our website. Click on the image below to go there, thanks!

- Abbey Games

notes.title: Welcoming new Players: Humble Monthly & 33% Discount
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.renownedexplorers.com/files/renowned_explorers_header.png[/img]

Today marks an important day for the community of Renowned Explorers, as we're about to welcome a lot of new players. That means new people to compare highscores to, more strategy discussion, more adventure stories and more of whatever nice things communities bring! We've been working together with Humble to make Renowned Explorers available for the subscribers of the Humble Monthly program. This means that not only will we see an influx of players from there, Renowned Explorers will also be in the spotlights as one of the top games of the bundle. Unfortunately you can't buy the bundle anymore, so to give people who missed out an extra reason to join our International Society, we're running a 33% discount for the coming week. Let's hope that a lot of new players join in!

[img]http://www.renownedexplorers.com/files/pinkerton_excited_small.png[/img]
[i]Chairman Pinkerton will not get a lot of sleep these days, but he's always fond of new recruits![/i]

[b]Some history[/b]
Renowned Explorers has been released 7 months ago and the veteran explorers among you know that it has already been a long adventure since. During initial release in September we received a lot of warm reception from the first players (93% positive!), but we weren't even close to recouping development costs. While the game itself was, and is a huge achievement for us, we want to keep doing what we do! Fortunately there were still a lot of people we could reach with this game (and there still are). So we decided to keep working on the game a little longer and in October we released the Mali expedition to all players for free. Right after its release we were in for a surprise: a renowned Youtuber humbled us with a strong recommendation to buy Renowned Explorers, and perhaps even better: he compared us to FTL. With renewed confidence we started our 2015 bi-weekly Patch program. While we planned to only do gameplay updates and fixes, we couldn't keep monks Adriaan and Marlies to create some extra content now and then. In December we had a great Winter sale and also started doing Weekly Challenges on the forums. It's basically a highscore competition, but it's also meant as inspiration for the story writers in the community. At that time we felt confident enough to start working on an actual full-size paid expansion.

[b]Future[/b]
This new expansion will contain both new expeditions and gameplay features. We'll tell you more about it as we go. It is always a risk for game studios to continue working on a released game, but we made that choice with confidence, as we see people play many hours, and requesting even more content. It's very rewarding to work for the veteran and rookie players, and we get to improve something that we hold dear. We hope this new surge of players will make Renowned Explorers and its community better, and we count on your help with that, be it by playing, posting, or just being friendly! Make sure your explorer-wannabe friends know about the discount, and hope to see you in the forums!

Have great adventures,
- Abbey Games

[img]http://www.renownedexplorers.com/img/abbey_games.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch #13: New Main Menu & Decreased Memory Usage
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.renownedexplorers.com/files/NewMainMenu.png[/img]
[i]The new main menu (left) and with community and news feeds minimized (right)[/i]

Patch #13 is online for Windows, Mac and Linux. Our content team is working on the expansion, so in the meanwhile the programmers have been working on a New Main Menu and on decreasing memory usage.

Renowned Explorers attracts more players every day, and a part of those players play for dozens or even hundreds of hours. By now it's clear to us that Renowned Explorers' future is going to be a long one. This is the main reason Abbey Games is devoting most of its time to creating an expansion pack with new expedition content and a Campfire feature that will greatly extend replayability with more metagame progression. notes.title: Patch #11 & Expansion Announced!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.renownedexplorers.com/files/ImportantButtons.png[/img]

After months of updates we present you with the last update of our patch program in 2015. For those that want to keep discovering things in the new year, we have just announced great news on our [url=www.twitch.tv/abbeygames]Twitch channel[/url]:

[h1]We're busy working on an expansion for Renowned Explorers![/h1]
Its release is still far away and we can't give many details yet. We can say that we will be focusing on content by working on 2 exotic new expeditions. We also want to look into a feature that puts a lot more focus on relationships inside your crew, but this is not guaranteed yet. Make sure to keep an eye on our channels to stay informed! For example, sign up for our [url=http://reusgame.us6.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=a8cb3be367b8148a8f284a476&id=b8cbf27b92]newsletter[/url]. Since playing the expansion will change the game, we will start an Alpha program at some point, so that we can work with you to keep all current value intact.

Since we'll be focusing our efforts on the expansion, we will stop the bi-weekly update. We'll keep supporting, so expect 1 or 2 more patches until the expansion, but it won't be every two weeks!

And now, the contents of Patch #11. We focused on two frequent requests you had for the game. Read the detailed patch notes [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/0/520518688938133991/]here[/url] or just the highlights below!

[h1]Freeplay after 5th Expedition[/h1]
Renowned Explorers is about gaining as much Renown as possible before the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/0/487877107130610696/]Exploration Year[/url] is over. To this end you have come up with many creative, smart and powerful strategies. Since you are judged for your score after 5 expeditions (which is important for the game design) you sometimes don't get to enjoy your full power when your strategy's end game kicked in. With this Patch we introduced the option to continue playing after your 5th expedition. This allows you to buy that one extra item, or finish the research tree, reach max level or test out your crew in Shangri-La without losing the game. It's important to note that you won't get another chance at beating Rivaleux' score: you are judged after 5 expeditions and any new expeditions are purely for your own fun, as the challenge of time pressure is gone. But still, you get to explore the entire world with your crew!

[h1]Encounter movement[/h1]
Renowned Explorers is a Turn-based Strategy game. This makes it about making interesting choices, rather than hand eye coordination. Sometimes you (and we as well) had the problem of misclicking a tile during movement. In a dangerous situation this could end your entire adventure. To relieve this we introduced the Undo Move button which allows you to redo your very last movement (not action!). Together with the ability to spend movement in multiple clicks, this will definitely ease your encounter play.

notes.title: Patch #10: New Research, Pedrinho, Supplies, Twitch
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.renownedexplorers.com/files/NewTechTrees.png[/img]

A few months ago we promised to update Renowned Explorers every two weeks in 2015. Even in these last few weeks, we have 2 more big Patches planned for you! One for today, and one for later in December. These patches greatly increase the replayability of Renowned Explorers so that you can have many more fresh adventures next year. And while our patch program will not continue in 2016, we will be announcing exciting news for Renowned Explorers's future. It will be even better than bi-weekly patches so keep an eye out the coming weeks!

But for now, let's introduce this patch's major changes. Read the full notes [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/0/520518688938133991/]here[/url], including many small balance changes and fixes.

[h1]Completely new Tech Trees [/h1]
While the previous tech trees offered lots of different strategies already, we believed they focused too much on specific character classes. This means that your Research strategy was largely determined by your crew choice. To increase the number of available strategies we created entirely new Research Trees. These new trees focus on very different aspects and allow you more control over your Supplies capacity. We've already found a lot of new strategies, and trust that you will find even more. Start up the game now to test it out. And let us know what you think!

[img]http://www.renownedexplorers.com/files/FUNraiser.png[/img]

[h1]Pedrinho's new Captain Perk[/h1]
If you've been playing Renowned Explorers these past few weeks, you'll have noticed that we're gradually improving Captain Perks for several characters. This Patch it's Pedrinho's turn. His new Captain Perk 'FUNraiser' focuses on his qualities as a party host to gain funds during Campaign jobs across the world.

[h1]Supplies[/h1]
The new Research trees grant you much more control over the amount of Supplies you bring on expeditions. Supplies are a powerful tool for increasing your expedition length. To keep the game fun we balanced a lot of the supply costs and gains for traveling and rewards. So don't be surprised if your expeditions from now on seem harder or different. Just make sure you prepare well with the new Research tree!

[img]http://www.renownedexplorers.com/files/TwitchNotice.png[/img]

[h1]Twitch Stream[/h1]
Tomorrow at 18:00 GMT / 10:00 PST we will be hosting a Live Stream in which we discover legendary Patch #10 strategies. Make sure to join in and tell us about your strategies or tell us how to play better. You're all welcome on our [url=http://www.twitch.tv/abbeygames]Twitch channel[/url]. We will also be introducing the next [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/0/485623406962160120/]weekly challenge[/url].

[h1]Fan Fiction Directory[/h1]
Inspired by a wide range of personalities in Renowned Explorers, some creative community members have started writing stories such as 'Anna's Smile' and 'The Mysterious Missing Mr. Pinkerton'. Find them in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/0/485623406962125407/]Fan Fiction Directory[/url]. Or write your own and have it added!

notes.title: Patch 4: Pretty full of improvements.
notes.notes:
While we aim to release a big content patch in the middle of October, there's a lot of things that we could do to improve your experience right now.

For the full change notes, go to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/296970/discussions/0/520518688938133991/]change notes topic[/url]. Below follows a description of the important changes.

[b]Captain Perks[/b] - Many people noticed that Anna's Captain Perk, a bonus that you get for selecting her as captain, is stronger and more fun than other perks. We thought about nerfing it, but since a lot of people enjoy playing like that, we decided to keep it in. Instead we experimented with some replacement Captain Perks for other Captains that play equally nicely to Anna's and Kiwi's captain perks. So try out Yvonne, Charles and Dolores to find their new captain perks that will influence your strategy during the whole game.

[b]Character Inspection during Menus[/b] - There were complaints about not being able to inspect perks, stats or items while shopping around, making a choice in a Story or doing something else. Frankly, we were clicking around too much ourselves as well. From this patch on, you can click your character's portraits while in a Entourage/Item Shop, Story or any other UI to make a better choice. You can't however swap items while doing something else.

[b]Loads of balance[/b] - Adriaan, our lead designer whom you may know as AbbeyAdriaan in the Community Hub,has been keeping an eye on how people play by looking at your posts and our testers. Informed by you, he made many small changes to increase the number of viable strategies and tweak the challenge curve. Check the full patch notes to see what changed.

[b]Achievements[/b] - A number of people discovered that a few achievements didn't trigger correctly. We can now say with certainty that you can 100% complete Renowned Explorers. Good luck, expedition leaders.

[b]A Bunch of Fixes[/b] - Rutger, one of the gameplay programmers at the Abbey, has been fixing a bunch of small issues that were reported here on the forums or elsewhere. Again, view the full notes for this. Think of serialization problems, interfaces for small screens.

[i]As reward for reading through this, here's a preview for what we'll release in October. Make sure you join our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/296970]Steam Group[/url] to hear about all updates.[/i]

[img]http://www.renownedexplorers.com/files/october.png[/img]

We hope all these improvements help you enjoy the game more and longer.

Venture forth!

notes.title: First update: Content about Difficulty
notes.notes:
Renowned Explorers has been out for just a week. We're glad and proud to say that there are many players enjoying the game. The community already welcomed a lot of people posting their adventures, helping each other and discussing balance. The subject of difficulty came up often. Many liked it, many found it too hard, and some of the more masochistic people found it too easy. 

A perfect fit for Difficulty Options. We now offer Easy, Normal, Classic and Impossible to make sure that every player can adjust the experience to their liking. You select it at the start of every game, and it will be shown in your score screen. For the people that liked the game as it was: Classic has exactly the same balance as the game at launch.

To make sure that ambitious expedition leaders always have More to Explore, we also added in a bit of new content in the existing expeditions. You'll have to discover it to know what it is :) For the rest of our intentions, please consult the Game Roadmap pinned in the Community Hub. Patch notes can be discovered there as well.

Other than adding in difficulties and content, we fixed some issues that people were experiencing.

We wish you many more happy and appropriately hard adventures!
- Abbey Games
